title: MISO-BR: An Open Corpus for Misogyny Detection in Brazilian Portuguese
abstract: arXiv:2611.14036v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Misogyny is among the most prevalent forms of online hate speech directed at Brazilian users, yet open and auditable resources dedicated to it in Brazilian Portuguese remain scarce. We introduce MISO-BR, an open, documented and versioned corpus of 896 balanced social media texts annotated for binary misogyny, released with its construction protocol and reproducible baselines. The corpus combines lexicon- and target-guided scraping from X with items imported from OLID-BR, a large language model triage stage whose prompt and decoding parameters are released, and manual annotation by three annotators following a written guide. Inter-annotator reliability reaches a Fleiss' kappa of 0.788 over 816 items. Under a single fixed protocol we compare four classical classifiers (Multinomial and Bernoulli Naive Bayes, a linear SVM and a random forest) with fine-tuned BERTimbau Base and Large. The classical models cluster between 0.651 and 0.676 mac

translated_title: MISO-BR：一个用于巴西葡萄牙语厌女症检测的开放语料库
translated_abstract: 厌女症是针对巴西用户最普遍的网络仇恨言论形式之一，然而专门针对巴西葡萄牙语的开放且可审计的相关资源仍然稀缺。我们推出了MISO-BR，这是一个开放的、有完整文档记录且版本化的语料库，包含896条平衡分布的社交媒体文本，标注了二元厌女症标签，并随附其构建协议和可复现的基线。该语料库结合了从X平台进行的基于词典和目标的定向抓取、从OLID-BR导入的项目、一个大语言模型筛选阶段（其提示词和解码参数均已公开），以及三名标注者按照书面指南进行的人工标注。在816个项目上，标注者间信度达到Fleiss' kappa 0.788。在单一固定协议下，我们比较了四种经典分类器（多项式朴素贝叶斯、伯努利朴素贝叶斯、线性SVM和随机森林）与微调后的BERTimbau Base和Large模型。经典模型的宏平均F1分数聚集在0.651至0.676之间。
tldr: 该论文推出了MISO-BR——首个面向巴西葡萄牙语厌女症检测的开放、有文档记录且版本化的标注语料库，附带完整的构建协议、标注指南和可复现的基线模型，填补了该领域开放资源的空白。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MISO-BR, the first open, documented, and versioned corpus for misogyny detection in Brazilian Portuguese, released with its full construction protocol, annotation guidelines, and reproducible baselines, filling a gap in open resources for this task.
